# Postmark: integration analysis

> Generated by API Integration Scout from <https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview> on 2026-10-07T08:36:26.374Z.
> Every finding is marked **Documented** (quoted from the docs and verified), **Inferred** (the agent's reasoning) or **Not found in docs**.

Postmark is a REST/JSON email delivery API for transactional and bulk email. It covers sending (single, batch, template), bounces, message search, servers, domains, sender signatures, stats, suppressions, inbound processing and webhooks.

## At a glance

| Area | Finding | Status | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base URL | https://api.postmarkapp.com | Documented | [/developer/api/overview](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview) |
| Authentication | api_key: Server Token for server-level requests (send email, bounces, etc.). Each reference page states which token to use. (+1 documented alternative) | Documented | [/developer/api/overview](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview) |
| Pagination | offset: Bounce search uses count (max 500) and offset; count+offset cannot exceed 10,000, so use fromdate/todate to retrieve more. Other endpoints were not checked. | Documented | [/developer/api/bounce-api](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/bounce-api) |
| Rate limits | — | Not found in docs | [/developer/api/overview](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview) |
| Webhooks | Yes: Delivery, Bounce, Spam complaint, Open, Click, Subscription change, Inbound | Documented | [/developer/webhooks/webhooks-overview](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/webhooks/webhooks-overview) |
| Error format | JSON body with numeric ErrorCode and Message. The code is also echoed in the X-PM-ApiErrorCode header. Most input errors are HTTP 422; auth failures are 401. Batch sends return per-message codes inside a 200. | Documented | [/developer/api/overview](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview) |
| Versioning | — | Not found in docs | [/developer/api/overview](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview) |
| Endpoints | 5 found | 4 documented, 1 inferred | — |

## Risks

- **HIGH**: No webhook signatures. Webhooks are not signed. You must rely on Basic auth in the URL, IP allowlisting and payload validation.
- **MEDIUM**: Rate limits undocumented. The docs mention 429 but give no numeric limits or rate-limit headers on the pages read.
- **MEDIUM**: No versioning policy found. The URLs have no version and no versioning or changelog policy was found.
- **MEDIUM**: Two token types. Server and account tokens apply to different endpoints. Using the wrong one returns 401 (error code 10).
- **MEDIUM**: Batch partial failures. Batch sends return HTTP 200 with per-message error codes, so you must inspect each result.
- **LOW**: Offset pagination cap. Bounce search is capped at 10,000 results and its date filters use Eastern Time.
- **LOW**: Sender and approval restrictions. Sending needs a confirmed Sender Signature, and new accounts are restricted until approved. The Bulk API requires approval.
- **LOW**: Incomplete page coverage. Fetched pages were truncated and only 5 pages were allowed, so most endpoints were not read.
- **LOW**: Unverified claim: endpoints[3] GET /bounces. The agent marked this as documented, but quote not found on https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/bounce-api. Treat it as inferred and confirm with the provider. _(verification check)_

## Open questions

- What are the numeric rate limits per token or server, and are rate-limit headers returned?
- Is there an API versioning or deprecation policy?
- Do other list endpoints (messages, suppressions, templates) use count/offset or other pagination?
- How many retry attempts does a webhook get, and over what schedule?
- Will HMAC webhook signing be added?

## Details

### Base URL

`https://api.postmarkapp.com`

**Status:** Documented
> "https://api.postmarkapp.com"
> — [https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview)

### Authentication (primary)

- Type: api_key
- Location: header
- Parameter: `X-Postmark-Server-Token`
- Server Token for server-level requests (send email, bounces, etc.). Each reference page states which token to use.

**Status:** Documented
> "Server Token — X-Postmark-Server-Token"
> — [https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview)

### Authentication alternatives

Other methods the docs state. Each has a sample request in the Postman "Auth alternatives" folder.

#### 1. api_key in header (X-Postmark-Account-Token)

- Type: api_key
- Location: header
- Parameter: `X-Postmark-Account-Token`
- Account Token for account-level endpoints (servers, domains, sender signatures, etc.).

**Status:** Documented
> "Account Token — X-Postmark-Account-Token"
> — [https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview)

### Endpoints

| Method | Path | Purpose | Key params | Status | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/email` | Send a single email | `From` (body, required), `To` (body, required), `HtmlBody` (body), `TextBody` (body), `MessageStream` (body), `X-Postmark-Server-Token` (header, required) | Documented | [/developer/api/email-api](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/email-api) |
| POST | `/email/batch` | Send up to 500 messages per call | `body` (body, required), `X-Postmark-Server-Token` (header, required) | Documented | [/developer/api/email-api](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/email-api) |
| GET | `/deliverystats` | Get bounce and inactive-email totals | `X-Postmark-Server-Token` (header, required) | Documented | [/developer/api/bounce-api](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/bounce-api) |
| GET | `/bounces` | Search bounces | `count` (query, required), `offset` (query, required), `type` (query), `fromdate` (query), `todate` (query) | Inferred | [/developer/api/bounce-api](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/bounce-api) |
| GET | `/bounces/{bounceid}` | Get a single bounce | `bounceid` (path, required) | Documented | [/developer/api/bounce-api](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/bounce-api) |

### Pagination

- Style: offset
- Parameters: `count`, `offset`
- Bounce search uses count (max 500) and offset; count+offset cannot exceed 10,000, so use fromdate/todate to retrieve more. Other endpoints were not checked.

**Status:** Documented
> "Count + Offset cannot exceed 10,000 bounces."
> — [https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/bounce-api](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/bounce-api)

### Rate limits

Not found in docs.

**Status:** Not found in docs
Source: [https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview)

### Webhooks

- Supported: yes
- Events: `Delivery`, `Bounce`, `Spam complaint`, `Open`, `Click`, `Subscription change`, `Inbound`
- Signature verification: No HMAC signing. Protect with HTTP Basic auth in the URL and IP allowlisting.
- Postmark POSTs JSON to your URL on events. Endpoints are verified on create/edit and must return 200. Non-2xx responses are retried. Event types that keep failing are paused.

**Status:** Documented
> "Postmark does not currently support HMAC webhook signature verification."
> — [https://postmarkapp.com/developer/webhooks/webhooks-overview](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/webhooks/webhooks-overview)

### Error format

JSON body with numeric ErrorCode and Message. The code is also echoed in the X-PM-ApiErrorCode header. Most input errors are HTTP 422; auth failures are 401. Batch sends return per-message codes inside a 200.

```json
{"ErrorCode": 403, "Message": "Invalid request field(s): 'From'."}
```

**Status:** Documented
> "it returns a JSON body with a numeric ErrorCode and a human-readable Message"
> — [https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview)
